body:
What makes a real estate company good to work for?

Four things, in roughly this order: support (training, a manager who isn’t competing against you, real systems), economics (your take-home after every fee, not the headline split), culture (do people stay?), and brand (does the name help you win business?). A high split at a firm that gives you none of the first three is rarely the best place to work, only the best place to pay fees.

Why Adams, Cameron & Co. ranks for Ormond Beach agents

Adams, Cameron & Co. has staffed a Granada Boulevard office in Ormond Beach since 1963, with around 300 agents firm-wide across Volusia and Flagler County. Agents cite the non-competing managers, the included marketing and technology, the training, and a genuine family culture. That’s why it appears on third-party “best places to work” lists. If support and a trusted local brand matter to you, it’s the established full-service choice.
